title: AUT-05 regression corpus (full: four failure families, controls, planning baseline)

cases.title: Canonical identity incomplete or contradictory
cases.sourceSnapshot: git HEAD 63eb95918c3986f3ad5ac237c22a6bafc5ef5530; target-orchestrator identity derivation; incident r209/r210
cases.goal: Reject/refrain from authorizing when the actual target contract requires identity fields that are incomplete or contradictory.
constraints: identity contradiction must be rejected, not coerced

oracle.requiredOutcome: reject: a persisted context manifest or capability grant that contradicts the canonical assignment identity is refused
forbiddenEffects: authorizing a task whose persisted identity contradicts the canonical assignment
checking only policy_version while ignoring write_scope/capability contradictions

knownLimitations: historical evidence is recorded in gitignored handoffs (.agents/teamwork/monitor-owner/handoff.md r209/r210)
no frozen digest for transient handoff evidence

cases.title: Nested manifests contradict each other
cases.sourceSnapshot: git HEAD 63eb95918c3986f3ad5ac237c22a6bafc5ef5530; target-orchestrator policy-projection derivation; incident QA-227-1/r227-r229
cases.goal: Retain disagreement between nested manifests and the contract's failure outcome; equality of one projection is insufficient.
constraints: both manifest projections must be validated, not one

oracle.requiredOutcome: reject: contradictory nested manifests produce the contract's failure outcome; validating only one projection is insufficient
forbiddenEffects: accepting a manifest when a nested manifest contradicts it
validating only policy_version while ignoring nested coverage

cases.title: Fixture/dispatcher producer mismatch
cases.sourceSnapshot: git HEAD 63eb95918c3986f3ad5ac237c22a6bafc5ef5530; proof derivation producer provenance; incident QP-212-01
cases.goal: Preserve required producer provenance; test both the expected producer and a lookalike/wrong producer.
constraints: producer must equal 'dispatcher' on both records

oracle.requiredOutcome: reject: proof derivation requires producer='dispatcher' on both records; a lookalike/wrong producer is refused
forbiddenEffects: accepting a proof whose producer is not the dispatcher
deriving authority from a record with missing/wrong producer

cases.title: Stale review continuation must be rejected before model execution
cases.sourceSnapshot: git HEAD 63eb95918c3986f3ad5ac237c22a6bafc5ef5530; target-orchestrator review.continuation boundary; incident r215
cases.goal: Observe rejection before model execution and distinguish a later fresh review from replay of the stale origin.

oracle.requiredOutcome: reject: a stale review continuation is refused before model execution (review_origin_unknown/review_origin_stale)
forbiddenEffects: replay of the stale origin as a fresh review
oracle.sourceContract: src/contracts.js review.continuation predicates and src/a2a-role-service.js admission boundary

knownLimitations: historical evidence in .agents/teamwork/root/handoff.md and blocker-decision-log.md (r215 review_origin_stale)

cases.title: Valid ordinary result with complete accepted evidence sequence
cases.sourceSnapshot: git HEAD 63eb95918c3986f3ad5ac237c22a6bafc5ef5530; target-orchestrator review chain; incident QP-212-01 acceptance
cases.goal: Preserve a positive control with a complete accepted evidence sequence, proving the adapter is not always-failing.
constraints: requires a current-target verifier then auditor receipt chain

oracle.requiredOutcome: pass: a complete accepted evidence sequence (current-target verifier then auditor) is recorded
forbiddenEffects: a usage row, task status, or passing sentence standing in for an accepted receipt
a stale or wrong-target receipt counted as accepted
oracle.sourceContract: src/review-policy.js current-target identity and src/lead-graph.js gate completion

knownLimitations: historical evidence in .agents/teamwork/monitor-owner/handoff.md (r214/r216 verifier -> r217 auditor passed m4-t312e1c2b3a-quota-proof)

cases.title: Failed/incomplete result with missing usage
cases.sourceSnapshot: git HEAD 63eb95918c3986f3ad5ac237c22a6bafc5ef5530; incident r212/r227 and TOK-OPT-01
cases.goal: Keep failure and unknown metrics; never fabricate acceptance or zero spend.
constraints: missing usage must remain unknown, never zero

oracle.requiredOutcome: inconclusive/fail: the failed result and unknown metrics are retained; no fabricated acceptance or zero spend
forbiddenEffects: recording a fabricated acceptance for a failed result
recording zero measured cost when cost is unknown
oracle.acceptedEvidenceType: failed/incomplete result with explicit missing-data reasons
oracle.sourceContract: docs/aut-05-baseline-runbook.md section 2 (usage is not an acceptance receipt) and src/usage-report.js measured.cost null

cases.title: AUT-01 planning baseline: frozen representative feature
cases.goal: Freeze one representative feature's canonical inputs and current-workflow planning output before AUT-01, with an independent reviewer-scored artifact baseline.

oracle.requiredOutcome: reviewer-scored artifact baseline: requirement_preservation records how many mandatory IDs the current output explicitly satisfies
forbiddenEffects: pre-correcting the current output's omissions before scoring
fabricating token/cost/timing metrics for the offline scope
oracle.acceptedEvidenceType: independent reviewer scoring of the frozen artifact

knownLimitations: current output is a single informal task with no requirement traceability
